description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). Saved presets (reusable single timers) and meals (named groups of dishes) in one call, with each meal's dishes resolved to real names and durations. Read this before start_timers, start_meal, edit_cookbook or delete_saved.
